description:
Implement decoding for the generic derived-code transformations of epic ae03bcd0: shortened, punctured, and one-symbol-extended codes wrap a mother code and carry an explicit coordinate map and derived information-set structure (transform layer of bch-api-design; coordinate-map provenance abstraction of issue 33812b86). Decoding must translate received coordinates through that map, delegate to the mother-code decoder, and report the same typed NoErrors/Corrected/Uncorrectable outcomes.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Shortened, punctured, and extended wrappers decode through their coordinate maps for every mother code with a canonical decoder, preserving the typed outcome contract.
- [hard] REQ-02: Property suites verify decode correctness across transformation compositions, including derived-dimension and information-set edge cases.
title: Decode shortened, punctured, and extended derived codes
